chembl_policy: Non-PubChem human single-protein IC50; B/F assay confidence >=8; exact positive nM value with pChEMBL, no validity flag or potential duplicate; exclude explicit TDI/mechanism-based/preincubation assay descriptions
pubchem_policy: AID1851 Max_Response per SID and isoform including inactive compounds; finite numeric values clipped [-150,50], median across standardized compound/isoform; original responses retained
identity_policy: Project ChEMBL parent standardization with stereochemistry retained; connectivity-block overlap exclusion against ALL challenge compounds, including blinded test and auxiliary-only molecules
replicate_policy: Median per assay/compound then median across assays for ChEMBL; median across SID rows for PubChem
